visualCharacteristics: Three-column grid of feature cards, each with an image (3:2), a title heading, and a short description paragraph. No category tag, date, or link. Three columns on desktop, single column on mobile.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row is a card with an image cell and a body cell (title + description).
usage: Showcase grid of trend/feature items with image, title, and blurb.
